# Deniz Karakoyun — The Deniz Tree

> Personal portfolio of Deniz Karakoyun, a Computer Engineering student at Middle East Technical University (METU, Ankara, Türkiye), class of 2027. Focus: operating systems, low-level systems programming, embedded software, C/C++. Co-founder and developer of two shipped products (Guild, Phera Labs). The site is an interactive "tree" — the same content is also available as plain text on the page (section id "cv-text") and as JSON-LD.

## Who

- Computer Engineering student at METU, CGPA 3.61 / 4.00, expected graduation 2027. Ranked 799th out of ~3,000,000 in Türkiye's national university exam (YKS, 2021).
- Aiming at OS, embedded, robotics or infrastructure work — C, C++, Linux, ROS 2.

## Experience

- KUARTIS — Software Engineering Intern (2026 – present, Ankara): C++17 ROS 2 lifecycle node on NVIDIA Jetson for GNSS signal-health monitoring; test-first; fixed a data race in the multithreaded test harness.
- ASELSAN — Candidate Engineer (until Jul 2026): multithreaded C++ data pipelines processing millions of data points for system evaluation.
- ROMER (METU Robotics & AI Center) — Undergraduate Researcher (Jan – Jul 2026): CNN / ResNet models for honey-bee orientation detection.
- BİTES — Software Engineering Intern (Aug – Sep 2025): C# / WPF desktop app features, xUnit tests.
- ASELSAN — Intern (Jul – Aug 2025): C++ unit tests (GoogleTest) for embedded systems; Python GUI test automation.
- EXA4MIND (EU Horizon project) — Data Mining Intern (Aug – Sep 2024): streaming pipelines with Kafka, Flink, ZeroMQ; ZeroMQ vs Kafka benchmark.

## Products (shipped)

- Guild — student community app for Turkey (iOS, Android, web); co-founder and sole developer; live at nine universities. https://getguild.app
- Phera Labs — art-tech platform for student digital art; co-founder and developer; 360° gallery, commerce. https://pheralabs.com

## Selected projects (systems)

- Concurrent data pipeline orchestrator in C (fork/exec, IPC over Unix domain sockets).
- Y86-64 pipelined processor: added instructions, resolved hazards in HCL; optimized a bilateral filter from 1442 to 688 cycles/element (2.1×).
- Bomb & Attack Labs: x86-64 reverse engineering with GDB; code-injection and ROP exploits in a sandboxed lab.
- PIC18 embedded systems: Flappy Bird on an LED matrix with interrupts; timer-free round-robin scheduler.
- Flight Finder (C++, multigraph + Dijkstra), AI Model Hub database (SQL schema design), KSO marine-biodiversity platform architecture (74-page SAD).
